monthly_timing: first SPY session open; first added contribution is February of each window
dip_signal: Yesterday raw close <= .95 * highest raw close of 252 sessions BEFORE yesterday; buy all available cash at next session adjusted open
immediate: Initial and every later monthly contribution invested at arrival open
dca: Initial capital split across first 12 monthly opens; new monthly cash invested on arrival; all residual cash/interest invested at month12 and subsequent monthly opens
dividends: Adjusted-close total-return proxy and same-day adjusted open; no second cash dividend credit; exact pay-date DRIP not modeled
cost_status: Project gross/purchase-friction scenarios, not calibrated brokerage cost
cash_interest: Simple daily accrual ACT/365 on prior cash, using latest DGS3MO observation strictly before prior SPY session; current vintage, not authenticated publication-time data
windows: All 17 overlapping calendar-year-start ten-year windows 2000-2009 through 2016-2025, both cash modes, zero purchase friction; not independent samples
exposure: Public historical market data and source format inspected before this plan; no fresh holdout or preregistration claim
rule: No threshold/window tuning or automatic Paper promotion after results; publish all scenarios
